topic: Shanks saved Koby at Marineford, a setup for Koby vs Luffy
title: Why Shanks Saved Koby At Marineford (Not Luffy)
description: Shanks stopped Akainu from killing Koby at Marineford. Here's why that moment might matter more for Luffy's endgame than anyone admits. Is Koby Luffy's final obstacle?
comment: Will Koby end up fighting Luffy, or standing beside him? Pick one.

lines.text: Shanks didn't just save Luffy at Marineford. He saved Koby.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate blocking a magma fist

lines.text: And I think that's the part Oda wants us to remember.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate on a battlefield

lines.text: Chapter 574. Akainu is about to strike Koby down.

shot.fallback: admiral raising a magma fist over a boy

lines.text: Shanks steps in, and the war ends with one conversation.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate stopping a magma fist

lines.text: Everyone remembers that as Shanks ending the war. But look at who he actually saved.

shot.fallback: pirate standing over a boy in marine coat

lines.text: A kid who'd just begged both sides to stop fighting.

shot.fallback: marine cadet shouting on a battlefield

lines.text: Today that kid is a Marine hero, trained by Garp himself.

shot.fallback: old marine hero training a young marine

lines.text: People say Koby is Luffy's friend, so he'd never stand in his way.
But reports on this theory point out Koby has learned what finding the One Piece could mean.
So maybe Shanks wasn't only protecting a future Pirate King. He was protecting the one man who might have to stop him.

shot.fallback: pirate between a marine and a boy in straw hat

lines.text: That's my read, and it fits Shanks perfectly.
Shanks didn't just save Luffy at Marineford...

shot.fallback: red haired pirate blocking a magma fist
